statement: Some studied superset arrangements shorten sessions and can increase perceived effort; longitudinal and safety conclusions require separate appraisal.
scope: Adult resistance-training protocols in the review; no universal pairing or individualized safety claim
forbidden_inference: Half the time with identical results for everyone

statement: Equipment comparisons depend on the strength test; no detected hypertrophy difference does not establish exact equivalence of every exercise.
scope: Programs included in the equipment review, not arbitrary exercise substitutions
forbidden_inference: Any two exercises for the same muscle are interchangeable or equally safe

statement: The equipment review contains different evidence counts for different outcomes.
scope: A worked example of evidence appraisal
forbidden_inference: The total number of studies supports every outcome equally
